scope: Additive Super Wizard Tower L1-L2 and Supercharge Chain Magic baseline.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: Confirms TH18 merging and chaining to up to 15 nearby enemies, but not target eligibility/order, radius, decay, launch, collision, loss or fixed-tick timing.

sources.title: Super Wizard Tower
sources.limitations: Reports range 8, 1.3-second attack rate, 4-tile branch radius, 15 other chained targets and 40% secondary damage, but no immutable client build, replay trace or deterministic selection/timing contract.

sources.title: Super Wizard Tower payload
sources.limitations: Pins L1-L2 and Supercharge numeric values, footprint, range, cadence and air/ground target metadata, but not the Chain Magic selection or projectile lifecycle.

chain_damage_multiplier.note: Each branch victim takes 40% of the primary strike.

chain_target_count.note: The source describes the primary plus up to 15 other targets; Core's count includes the primary target.

chain_radius_tiles.note: Branches are measured from the primary target.

support.note: Shared Core branches from the primary and uses distance/entity-ID ties. Exact eligibility, in-game target ordering and projectile lifecycle remain explicitly partial.

known_uncertainties: The public sources do not publish target eligibility, branch selection/ties, a footprint-edge measurement, projectile trajectory/speed, collision, retarget/loss behavior or same-tick event ordering.
Core uses the documented primary-rooted 4-tile radius and a deterministic distance/entity-ID tie-break. This is an explicit reproducibility baseline, not a claim of exact client target selection.
The public image path is catalogued, but Super Wizard-specific chain visual timing and effect geometry remain unverified.
conclusion: Super Wizard Tower L1-L2 and Supercharge share a deterministic primary-rooted Chain Magic baseline through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL; target selection, collision, trajectory and visual fidelity remain partial.
